title: Subscription billing: Razorpay for India, Stripe elsewhere, behind one gateway interface with idempotent webhooks
goal: Let an agency pay its subscription online in its own currency, and keep the subscription status in step with payments automatically.
why: No checkout exists anywhere; the only Razorpay code is a webhook in the super-admin app that skips signature checks when the secret is unset (deleted in R112); there is no Stripe; trial and subscription states are set by hand (record-payment).
steps: Follow READINESS-PLAN 4.10. Master 0020: billing_customers (tenant_id, gateway, customer_id), billing_events (gateway, event_id UNIQUE together, type, payload_hash, received_at, processed_at), platform_invoices (number, tenant_id, period, currency, subtotal, tax_lines JSON, total, status, gateway_ref, issued_at); subscriptions gets gateway, gateway_subscription_id, current_period_end, past_due_since.

gateway.ts interface; razorpay.ts (Subscriptions API create, signature HMAC-SHA256 of raw body with RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET, events subscription.charged/halted/cancelled, payment.failed), stripe.ts (Checkout Session mode subscription with price from plan_prices via a Stripe price id column or price_data, Stripe-Signature t=,v1= HMAC-SHA256 with 300 s tolerance, events checkout.session.completed, invoice.paid, invoice.payment_failed, customer.subscription.deleted), mock.ts (local: checkout returns http://localhost/<...>/mock-checkout that, when hit through a TEST_MODE route, posts a signed mock event). All HTTP via fetch; no SDK dependency.

routes/billing.ts: POST /billing/checkout (tenant admin; the flat yearly plan price plus any extra users at the catalogue extra-user price -> checkout URL; gateway by tenant market: IN -> Razorpay, else Stripe, BILLING_GATEWAY=mock overrides), GET /billing/subscription, POST /billing/cancel; public POST /api/v1/billing/webhooks/:gateway mounted before auth: verify, INSERT OR IGNORE billing_events first, process only when inserted, update subscriptions and tenant status (trial/active/past_due/expired/cancelled; delete KV tenant cache), issue platform_invoices on payment.
Daily job: past_due older than 7 days -> expired.

Desktop settings/billing page (admin only): current plan, seats, renewal date, Upgrade/Change seats (opens checkout URL in the system browser via shell.openExternal in Electron, window.open on web), invoices list with download; graceful state when billing is not configured.

Super admin: admin.ts subscription views read the new fields (console page update is small; if it needs super-admin edits, write them into the report as a follow-up rather than editing super-admin here).
tests: backend/test/billing-webhooks.test.ts: fixture events signed with test secrets move a tenant trial -> active (checkout completed) -> past_due (payment failed) -> expired (daily job after 7 days) -> active again (paid); each event replayed twice changes nothing the second time; bad signature -> 400 and no row; Stripe timestamp older than 5 minutes -> 400; checkout picks Razorpay for IN and Stripe for GB.
gate: cd backend && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failed files and passed >= the last merged count (1296 on 2026-10-14)
cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # pass: 0 failing files, passed >= last merged count (1294 on 2026-10-14)
goLiveVerify: Test-mode checkout end to end with the owner's Stripe and Razorpay test keys; live keys and webhook endpoints registered; platform invoice tax wording with the accountant (Q10 legal entity).
notes: Before editing read: this batch file, docs/readiness/READINESS-PLAN.md sections 0 and the design note for this area, desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3-4 (executor rules, worktree bootstrap with node_modules junctions; never npm install inside a worktree unless the batch adds a dependency, and then only in the main checkout by the orchestrator).

Backend tests follow the existing pattern (see backend/test/voip-callbacks.test.ts): import env, createExecutionContext, waitOnExecutionContext, applyD1Migrations from cloudflare:test; applyD1Migrations(env.MASTER_DB, env.TEST_MIGRATIONS) in beforeAll; POST /api/v1/test/reset; call worker.fetch(request, env, ctx). isolatedStorage is false and singleWorker true, so use unique ids/emails per test file.
New ids use generateId() (UUIDv7) from backend/src/utils/uuid.ts. D1 conventions: TEXT ISO dates, REAL money, TEXT JSON, INTEGER booleans.
Compute HMACs over the exact raw body (await c.req.text() before any JSON parse).
